zitadel_runtime_environment.sanitized_startup_result: ZITADEL attempted PostgreSQL at 127.0.0.1:5432 instead of the healthy zitadel-db service

root_cause: Normal Coolify Compose deployment omitted the source service-scoped env_file declarations from the deployable Compose. The runtime services therefore started without their SOPS-derived service environment files.
next_action: Use Raw Compose with repository-owned Traefik routes, the resource-specific external network, and resource-rooted host secret mounts; require exact-head CI and Security before redeploying.
